quiz.question: After a password change, Outlook keeps asking for the password. Good first step?
options: Sign out of the Office apps and sign back in
quiz.answer_text: Sign out of the Office apps and sign back in
quiz.why: Outlook is still holding the old password. Signing out and back in (and clearing old entries in Credential Manager) usually fixes it.
